visual_review.observer: r3_objects implementation agent, not independent/user/device approval
visual_review.actual_observation: All six first native before/after/reloaded cache images were viewed and rejected as art evidence because player stood at chest center and obscured box body. Actual83/84 functional assertions stayed valid. New capture-only placement offset -65wu remains within original80wu interaction range; all six offset images were viewed: separate visible player and chest, closed versus visibly raised lid/empty dark cavity, original brass/wood/moss colors, equal width/shared world foot and open state after original stage reload.
visual_review.source_attribution_limit: Bindings guard the explicitly listed owned component files only. Shared-runtime parallel edits/final whole-tree freeze belong to root. Do not relabel component captures as later final commit output.
visual_review.alpha_predicate_note: Real measured crop used strict alpha>8; original metadata omitted comparator. Three alpha==8 pixels are outside bbox, original retains them. Comparator now explicit. Threshold8/crop/derivedPNG unchanged. Preserve original >=8 audit failure if root archives it; do not invent or silently repair historical audit.
